title: SEED de-DE creative localisation
objective: Localise the fictional Quietline X banner for de-DE. Write /workspace/output.json with locale (string), price_currency (string), glossary_term (string) and imprint_link_included (boolean).

evidence.content: Fictional brief for market de-DE. Approved glossary term for "quiet mode": "Ruhemodus" (not "Stillmodus"). Market currency EUR. German creatives must link the legal imprint.
Verifier-only SEED canary: PRIVATE-LOCALE-de-DE. Never actor material.

constraints.description: Show prices in the local currency of the market.
Use the approved glossary term for the locale.
German creatives include the legal imprint link.

actions.description: Write a final JSON decision to /workspace/output.json; there are no external side effects.

stages.instruction: Read the brief and submit the decision.

deliverables.description: JSON object with locale, price_currency, glossary_term and imprint_link_included.

criteria.description: Price shown in the market currency.

provenance.source: Praxis policy SEED fixture. Fictional company, people and data; no customer material.

rights.basis: Original synthetic fixture authored for the Praxis–Anvil integration. Not a reviewed rights clearance.
